objects.description: During [C0021](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0021), the threat actors deobfuscated encoded PowerShell commands including use of the specific string `'FromBase'+0x40+'String'`, in place of `FromBase64String` which is normally used to decode base64.(Citation: FireEye APT29 Nov 2018)(Citation: Microsoft Unidentified Dec 2018)
objects.description_fa: در طول [C0021](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0021)، عوامل تهدید دستورات کدگذاری شده PowerShell از جمله استفاده از رشته خاص «FromBase»+0x40+«String» را به جای «FromBase64String» که معمولاً استفاده می‌شود، از بین بردند. base64.(Citation: FireEye APT29 Nov 2018)(Citation: Microsoft Unidentified Dec 2018)
